findings.evidence: Mathlib defines `WideSubquiver` at `Mathlib/Combinatorics/Quiver/Subquiver.lean:27`; this file opens `namespace TauCeti` at line 57 and `namespace WideSubquiver` at line 59, while the public declarations at lines 254, 273, and 303 all have explicit parameter `(T : WideSubquiver ...)`.
findings.fix: Remove the enclosing `namespace TauCeti` (or otherwise declare these under `_root_.WideSubquiver`) so consumers get `T.symmetrifiedTreeSetCard`, `T.nonTreeEdgeCard`, and `T.spanningTreeBasis`.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.WideSubquiver.symmetrifiedTreeSetCard`, `nonTreeEdgeCard`, and `spanningTreeBasis` take a Mathlib `WideSubquiver` as their first explicit argument, so the naming rule requires the root `WideSubquiver` namespace.

summary: The three public declarations are nested under the wrong namespace for dot notation and upstream compatibility.
